topics.name: Introduction to Integers
topics.summary: Understanding negative numbers, positive numbers, and zero as a complete set of integers.

topics.name: Addition and Subtraction of Integers
topics.summary: Learning rules to add and subtract integers using number lines and algebraic principles.

topics.name: Multiplication of Integers
topics.summary: Mastering the sign rules for multiplying positive and negative integers.

topics.name: Division of Integers
topics.summary: Applying rules of signs to divide integers and understanding properties like division by zero.

topics.name: Properties of Integers
topics.summary: Studying closure, commutative, associative, and distributive properties under various operations.

topics.name: Multiplication of Fractions
topics.summary: Multiplying whole numbers by fractions, proper fractions, and improper fractions.

topics.name: Division of Fractions
topics.summary: Dividing fractions by utilizing the reciprocal of the divisor fraction.

topics.name: Decimal Representation
topics.summary: Understanding place value in decimals and converting between fractions and decimals.

topics.name: Operations on Decimals
topics.summary: Performing addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with decimal numbers.

topics.name: Application of Decimals
topics.summary: Solving real-world word problems involving units of measurement like money, length, and weight.

topics.name: Concept of a Variable
topics.summary: Understanding how letters or symbols represent unknown quantities in mathematical expressions.

topics.name: Setting Up an Equation
topics.summary: Translating verbal statements and real-life situations into mathematical equations.

topics.name: Solving Equations by Balancing
topics.summary: Finding the root of an equation by performing identical operations on both sides.

topics.name: Transposition Method
topics.summary: Simplifying equation solving by moving terms from one side to the other with inverted signs.

topics.name: Applications to Practical Problems
topics.summary: Using linear equations with one variable to solve puzzle-like word problems.

topics.name: Basic Geometric Terms
topics.summary: Defining points, lines, line segments, rays, and planes in geometry.

topics.name: Complementary and Supplementary Angles
topics.summary: Identifying pairs of angles whose measures sum up to 90 degrees or 180 degrees respectively.

topics.name: Adjacent and Linear Pair Angles
topics.summary: Recognizing adjacent angles and special linear pairs that form a straight line.

topics.name: Vertically Opposite Angles
topics.summary: Understanding that intersecting lines form equal pairs of vertically opposite angles.

topics.name: Angles made by a Transversal
topics.summary: Studying interior, exterior, corresponding, and alternate angles formed by a transversal across parallel lines.
